changelog: New: Appearance presets — name, save and share your look (theme, glass, layout) with friends; restore theirs in one tap. Your account never leaves your phone. Share YumeMusic now points to nzr.is-a.dev/yume-music. Update announcements rebuilt: popup on every app open, a Home card with a 3-day countdown, playback pauses after 3 days until you update.
